generalSettings.promptTextMessage: First add reference layers of interest. Then filter the plans and priorities and spatial priorities of interest to target the data you are looking for. Finally, use this tool to discover overlaps within you area of interest and in relation to the relevant spatial data. To use this tool, use either the select tool to select existing polygon(s) or use the drawing tools to place a place a point, line, or polygon on the map.  Double-click to end your drawing of a line or polygon. Results are available for export, see User Guide for details.
